Skip the run after as well, guarded by the updated_at the first skip answered

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_recurring_list and retry with an id from the list.
failure_modes.when: id does not name a recurring template in your tenant

failure_modes.recovery: For an ended template, send a later ends_on or a larger max_invoices with invoice_recurring_update first. For a change, call invoice_recurring_read and retry with its updated_at.
failure_modes.when: the template has ended (its next invoice would be dated after ends_on, or it has made max_invoices invoices), or it changed since expected_updated_at

failure_modes.recovery: Send only id and, optionally, expected_updated_at.
failure_modes.when: an argument it does not take, a missing id, or an expected_updated_at that is not an integer

preconditions: Skipping moves next_due by one period (a monthly template on the 1st goes from 1 Oct to 1 Nov) and makes no invoice; an ended template refuses. Nothing is sent to anyone.

description: Skips a recurring template's next invoice: next_due moves one period on (the template's own weekly, monthly or yearly day) and no invoice is made. A skip does not count toward max_invoices. Refuses NOT_FOUND for an id outside your tenant (call invoice_recurring_list) and CONFLICT when the template has ended (raise ends_on or max_invoices with invoice_recurring_update) or changed since expected_updated_at (read it again). Each call skips one run: to skip the run after, send expected_updated_at from this answer. Nothing is sent. NEXT: invoice_recurring_read.

expected_updated_at.description: Optional compare-and-set guard: the updated_at you last read. A mismatch returns CONFLICT and changes nothing.

id.description: The recurring template whose next invoice to skip (invoice_recurring_list shows ids).

name: invoice_recurring_skip
